LanguageData.LP_WL_Darkened.label: magical darkness
LanguageData.LP_WL_Darkened.description: Shrouded in a warlock's magical darkness: sight -50%. Warlocks with Devil's Sight are unaffected.
LanguageData.LP_WL_Hexed.label: hex
LanguageData.LP_WL_Hexed.description: Hexed by a warlock: damage taken from that warlock ×1.25, success of all saves -15%.
LanguageData.LP_WL_Caged.label: forcecage
LanguageData.LP_WL_Caged.description: Locked in an invisible cage of force: unable to move, damage taken ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_LegPatronAvatarBuff.label: patron's avatar
LanguageData.LP_LegPatronAvatarBuff.description: The patron lends you its power: warlock abilities cost no pact mana, ×1.5 power.
LanguageData.LP_WL_DevilSightBuff.label: devil's sight
LanguageData.LP_WL_DevilSightBuff.description: Sees clearly in the dark: sight in darkness +30%, unaffected by magical darkness.
LanguageData.LP_WL_DarkLuckBuff.label: dark one's own luck
LanguageData.LP_WL_DarkLuckBuff.description: The fiend's favor: mind resistance +10%, damage taken ×0.9.
LanguageData.LP_WL_FeyDefenseBuff.label: beguiling defenses
LanguageData.LP_WL_FeyDefenseBuff.description: The Archfey's protection: mind resistance +30%; enemies that hit you in melee have a 20% chance to be beguiled for 2 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WL_AwakenedMindBuff.label: awakened mind
LanguageData.LP_WL_AwakenedMindBuff.description: Whispers from beyond the stars have opened the mind: psychic sensitivity +20%, mind resistance +10% (psychic control is also easier to resist and shorter).
LanguageData.LP_WL_ThoughtShieldBuff.label: thought shield
LanguageData.LP_WL_ThoughtShieldBuff.description: The mind is guarded by a barrier: mind resistance +20%, psychic damage taken ×0.5.
